I will apply some DAP and urea that I received from the cooperative because the fruit trees need food to bear well, but I will keep the amount modest since this plot is rented and I must save inputs for my own land. I will also carry cow manure from my homestead and spread it around the trees, as we have done for generations. These are local fruit varieties, not new seedlings from the office, and I will not buy pesticides or irrigate because chemicals are too expensive and we have no pump or canal here. My family will weed, prune, and harvest this small plot ourselves over about twenty days this season, so I do not need to hire anyone.
